name: EPIC 212405238
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 17, 9.4 solar radii and 0.79 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 212405238 (K2 campaign 17): PARAM radius (solar radii) 9.40776 (16th-84th percentiles 9.247169-9.611808), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

temperature.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 212405238: APOGEE DR17 effective temperature 5053.965 +/- 50 K (the catalogue's final uncertainty)

distance.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 212405238 (K2 campaign 17): PARAM asteroseismic distance (pc) 3154.726562 (16th-84th percentiles 3111.328125-3200.585938), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

color.reason: PARAM fits an extinction A_V = 0.16 mag toward this star (Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, AV-M), and the colour routes do not remove extinction; APOGEE measured its temperature

text.card: A red giant 3,155 parsecs away, 9 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 17, give 0.79 solar masses and 9.4 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 5,054 K at its surface.
